lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 to 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical stripes are visible. Spacing is non-uniform, with wider gaps on the anterior torso (near the shoulder) and closer spacing on the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 2nd anterior stripe, which splits into a Y-shape at the dorsal ridge. A merging topology is visible between the 10th and 11th stripes at the mid-lateral level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1, 3, and 5 terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral line of the torso. Stripe 12 is composed of dashed, fragmented segments rather than a continuous line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 discrete white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two primary spots on the mid-posterior thigh exhibit a horizontal alignment forming a short geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots are present on the facial region below the eye. A large white transverse patch is visible at the ventral base of the neck.
